subject: Vendor security questionnaire: VPC boundary & EU residency confirmation
content:
From: Olivia Price <olivia.price@o-edge.com>

To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Muller <paul.muller@o-edge.com>
Subject: VPC boundary + data residency confirmation for SIG/CAIQ responses

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this through — our procurement/security team at O-Edge is completing the SIG and CAIQ for vendor onboarding. A few specific asks on hosting and network controls we need confirmed for our legal review:

- Is customer data for our tenancy guaranteed to reside in EU-only regions when we select EU hosting? Please confirm whether backups, logs, and metadata are also restricted to EU.
- For Private (VPC) deployments: does Redwood support private connectivity (VPC peering or PrivateLink) so that traffic never transits public internet? If so, outline options and whether there are any egress steps.
- KMS: can we use a customer-managed key in our cloud KMS (BYOK) for model input storage and logs?
- Network isolation evidence: can you provide a high-level network diagram and a couple of example configuration snippets (VPC routes, security group rules) suitable for our SIG evidence packet?

We appreciate any attachments (network diagram, SOC2 summary, CAIQ/SIG mapping) and a short note we can paste into the questionnaire.

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Price
Security Program Manager
O-Edge Pharmaceuticals

On 2026-11-15 10:08:34Z, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T10:08:34Z
To: Olivia Price <olivia.price@o-edge.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: VPC boundary + data residency confirmation for SIG/CAIQ responses

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, full details below and attached: 

- EU residency: yes. When a customer selects EU hosting we pin all customer workloads, storage, logs, and backups to EU regions only (primary + failover in EU regions). We do not replicate to US/APAC for EU-hosted tenancies unless explicitly enabled by the customer in the console.
- Private connectivity: supported. For Redwood Private in cloud deployments we offer (a) VPC peering, (b) AWS PrivateLink endpoints for API traffic, and (c) a managed VPN option for on-prem customers. In all cases, control plane traffic is separate from customer data plane traffic and you can enforce private routing so customer payloads do not traverse the public internet.
- KMS/BYOK: supported for our Private deployment option. Customers can supply a cloud KMS key (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault) and we encrypt at rest with that key for S3/Blobs that hold artifacts and logs. We can provide a KMS integration guide and the relevant IAM policy snippets.

I attached: redwood_network_diagram_v3.pdf (high-level network zones + peering options), SOC2-Type2-summary-2026.pdf (summary, no raw report), SIG-complete-redwood-20261115.xlsx (row-level answers), and vpc-configuration-snippets.txt (example route/security rules).

Below is a short paragraph you may paste into your questionnaire: 

"Redwood Inference confines EU-hosted customer data (including backups and operational logs) to EU physical regions. For Private deployments we provide VPC peering, PrivateLink endpoints, and managed VPN options to ensure customer traffic can remain within private networking boundaries; we also support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) for encryption of stored artifacts."

Let me know if you need ACL examples for a specific cloud provider or evidence of particular controls for SOC2/ISO for the SIG mapping.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Architect, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_network_diagram_v3.pdf; SOC2-Type2-summary-2026.pdf; SIG-complete-redwood-20261115.xlsx; vpc-configuration-snippets.txt

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: VPC boundary + data residency confirmation for SIG/CAIQ responses

Hi Paul / Olivia — following up with the specific operational details you requested: 

- Regions: EU primary deployments are supported in eu-west-1 (Ireland) and europe-west1 (Netherlands) depending on customer selection. Failover is typically configured to an alternate EU region (we avoid cross-continent failover for EU-tenancies by default).
- Replication model: backups and object storage replication are asynchronous; application-level state managed by customers can be configured for multi-zone redundancy. Our platform guarantees that backups and logs remain in EU regions and that replication targets are EU-only unless the customer opts in to cross-region replication.
- RTO/RPO: our standard Private offering provides an RTO of 1 hour for service tier Standard and a best-effort RPO of under 15 minutes for in-region replication for critical artifacts (we include these thresholds in our SLA addendum for Dedicated/Private contracts).

Attached again the network diagram and a short SIG-friendly paragraph and mapping tab in the spreadsheet. If you want, we can produce a signed confirmation letter on Redwood letterhead for your procurement folder.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_network_diagram_v3.pdf; SIG-complete-redwood-20261115.xlsx
